place.source_title: Jacob Shuh House, 718 West Main Street

brief: Early Greek Revival brick town house of 1837-38: two storeys, three bays with a side-hall entrance, low side-gabled roof with end chimneys, plain stone lintels and a small classical door surround, behind an iron fence. Record: 2 photos plus 8 measured drawing sheets (site, plans, elevations).

facade.notes: the Shuh House (1838): painted brick, two storeys, a heavy Greek Revival entablature with dentils, a side-hall entrance with a transom up steps, shutters; behind a cast-iron fence on a low wall along the sidewalk; spruces

why.note: the river town's front: a cast-iron fence on a low wall at the sidewalk, foundry-made (Madison had foundries)
